discarded_invocations: three earlier invocations of the same frozen runner and workload. Two measured the guard before it grew its scheduling barrier and are superseded rather than discarded on their numbers (guard_ns_per_block [2.832655,1.762741] and [2.615793,1.470476]); one more measured the shipped guard and was written to a path this record replaced ([2.887178,0.928835]). Nothing was tuned or retried to obtain a better number: the workload, the record shape and the validator were frozen before the first run and never changed.
note: miso-engine-audit links miso-engine-core with the realtime-audit feature, so the absolute bare/guarded ns/block carry that instrumentation. The guard delta does not: both arms pay it identically. At 48 kHz a 128-frame block is 2.67 ms, so the recorded guard cost is about one ten-thousandth of one percent of the block budget.
